SECTUR explicitly presents Xalapa as a city where urbanity and nature coexist, with parks, Macuiltépetl, El Haya, Jardín Botánico Clavijero and Naturalia; current nature/culture/urban profile remains supported.
Official destination page documents gastronomy, museums/cultural spaces, parks, botanical garden and ecological attractions; no S4 theme correction required.

Official destination page documents Playa de Chalchihuecan and Río Huitzilapan with exuberant vegetation, boat trips, swimming, fishing, rafting and kayak, in addition to historical and gastronomic attractions. Beach/coast and nature were under-coded.
SECTUR route description explicitly includes La Antigua and a boat trip on Río Huitzilapan surrounded by mangroves, confirming nature-linked tourism evidence.

SECTUR describes Poza Rica specifically as a notable petroleum city with cultural spaces; nature/adventure are regional Totonacapan attributes but are assigned to other municipalities in destination-specific descriptions.

Current SECTUR visitor guidance presents Poza Rica through petroleum history, civic monuments and urban culture, while nearby nature experiences are attributed to Tecolutla, Cazones, Costa Esmeralda and Zozocolco.
